data.label: Alpaca API
data.description: Primary broker for paper/live trading and historical market data (OHLCV). Provides REST and WebSocket APIs.

data.label: Yahoo Finance
data.description: Fallback data source for historical OHLCV and fundamental data (market cap, P/E, sector, dividends).

data.label: Discord
data.description: Messaging platform for trading alerts, monitoring, and bot commands.

data.label: AWS EC2
data.description: Production compute instance (t4g.small ARM64) running live trading strategies (OMR, RAMP, CSCM) as systemd services.

data.label: AWS Lambda + EventBridge
data.description: Serverless functions triggered by EventBridge cron rules to start/stop EC2 on market hours.

data.label: Interactive Brokers
data.description: Alternative broker integration via IB Gateway. Supports equities, options, and futures trading.

data.label: Parquet Storage
data.description: Hive-partitioned Parquet files for historical OHLCV. Schema: timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume, trade_count, vwap.

data.label: DuckDB Query Engine

entities.name: OHLCV Bar
entities.fields: timestamp DATETIME PK, open FLOAT64, high FLOAT64, low FLOAT64, close FLOAT64, volume FLOAT64, trade_count FLOAT64, vwap FLOAT64

data.description: In-process analytical database for fast querying of Parquet files.

data.label: Data Cache
data.description: Persistent Parquet cache with TTL metadata. Last-resort fallback when APIs are unavailable.

data.label: Strategy State Store
data.description: JSON-based state persistence for live trading positions. Atomic writes via temp file + rename with file locking.

data.label: Backtest Artifacts
data.description: Output storage for backtest results: CSV trade logs, HTML tearsheets, JSON metrics.

data.label: Data Acquisition Manager
data.description: Unified data download orchestrator with plugin architecture (Alpaca equities/crypto, Databento futures).

data.label: Composite Data Provider
data.description: Fallback chain: Alpaca (primary) -> YFinance (fallback) -> Cache (last resort). Canonical 8-column schema.

data.label: Streaming Service
data.description: Real-time WebSocket market data for live trading. 500-bar LRU buffer per symbol, auto-reconnect, REST fallback.

data.label: Strategy Registry
data.description: Dynamic strategy lookup by name with lazy loading.

data.label: OMR Strategy
data.description: Overnight Mean Reversion on leveraged ETFs. Bayesian probability model, 5 regimes. Entry 3:50 PM, exit 9:31 AM ET.

data.label: RAMP Strategy
data.description: Regime-Aware Momentum Protection on S&P 500. Dynamic 1/N position sizing, walk-forward validated Sharpe 1.859.

data.label: Research Strategies
data.description: Experimental strategies: MA crossover, mean reversion, momentum, pairs, breakout.

data.label: Market Regime Detector
data.description: Identifies 5 regimes: STRONG_BULL, WEAK_BULL, SIDEWAYS, UNPREDICTABLE, BEAR.

data.label: Backtest Engine
data.description: Core backtesting orchestrator. Loads via DuckDB, runs signals through portfolio simulator, generates tearsheets.

data.label: Portfolio Simulator
data.description: Bar-by-bar simulation with Numba JIT. Kelly/1-N/fixed sizing, stop losses, trade logging.

data.label: Optimization Engine
data.description: Grid, random, Bayesian (GP), genetic (DEAP). Walk-forward validation with rolling windows.

data.label: Reporting Engine
data.description: Standard report generation: monthly Sharpe/drawdown tables, metrics, regime analysis.

data.label: Live Trading Engine
data.description: Broker-agnostic live trading. Strategy adapters, execution engine with retry, multi-strategy state management.

data.label: Stock Screener
data.description: Finviz-like screener using Alpaca. Price, volume, technical (RSI, MACD, Bollinger), fundamental filters.

data.label: Discord Bot
data.description: Trading monitoring and alert bots. Portfolio commands, strategy status, CSCM crypto alerts.

data.label: Visualization Module
data.description: Candlestick charts with volume overlays, report generation, HTML/PNG/interactive formats.

data.label: Utilities
data.description: Rich logging (ASCII-only), Eastern Time tz, VIX data with fallbacks, TTL caching, trade logging.

data.label: Settings and Configuration
data.description: Centralized config: .env (API keys), settings.ini (paths), YAML configs.

data.label: Web Frontend
data.description: React 18 + Vite SPA. Strategy selector, symbol multi-select, config form, results dashboard.

data.label: Web API Backend

endpoints.description: Execute a backtest with given config
List all available strategies from the registry
Check backtest execution status and retrieve results

data.description: FastAPI server for the web UI. AsyncIO wrapper for backtest engine with response caching.

data.label: Desktop GUI
data.description: Cross-platform Flet app. Strategy selector, parameter editor, multi-worker parallel execution (1-16 workers).

data.label: CLI Backtest Runner
data.description: python -m src.backtest_runner --config config/backtesting/*.yaml

data.label: Terraform IaC
data.description: IaC for EC2, EIP, security groups, Lambda, EventBridge, CloudWatch, IAM.

data.label: YAML Config System
data.description: Backtesting YAML, strategy configs, trading configs, universe CSVs (S&P 500, Russell 1000/2000).
